{{Quote|A divided populace grieves over the loss of a peace-loving prophet&mdash;the high priestess Liora.|[[Micah Giiett]]|<ref name="Dark Side 1" />}}
'''Liora''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[High Priestess/Legends|High Priestess]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telos IV]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
[[File:Liora.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Liora falling to her death in a vision to Orykan Tamarik]]
Liora was a peace-loving [[High Priestess/Legends|High Priestess]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Telos IV]] during the buildup to the [[Telosian Civil War]]. In [[53 BBY/Legends|53 BBY]] the priestess was murdered, and her death was mourned by both factions of the planet's divided population. The murder drew the attention of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], who suspected that it might have in fact been a political [[Assassin/Legends|assassination]]. Believing the murder would be the final breaking point of the uneasy peace of Telos, the Council [[Mission to Telos (53 BBY)|sent]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Masters]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Tahl]] along with [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]] [[Xanatos]] and [[Orykan Tamarik]] to the [[Telos system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Dark Side 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Liora was created by [[Scott Allie]], writer of [[Star Wars: Jedi — The Dark Side|''Star Wars: Jedi—The Dark Side'']]. She was first mentioned in one panel in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic's]] [[Jedi — The Dark Side 1|first issue]]. In the [[Jedi — The Dark Side 2|second issue]] Liora made a brief appearance in a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] to Orykan Tamarik.
